source: Jensen 2024 DOI 10.1111/geb.13875; exact MD5 Pleistocene line/range files from stage18 source

case_jitter.sample: One uniform-in-disk 50km radial displacement in the species-local AEQD plane for every original case line-grid site. Reject proposed points outside corresponding source clipped/surveyed range; at most 20 proposals per site; if no success leave original case point and count it.

science: The jitter gates assess feasibility of spatial positional-uncertainty sensitivity, not genetic effectiveness or inference. The conditional-within-range displacement is not spatially uniform when range boundaries truncate the disk. No genetic break-history AUC is permitted without fresh predictor extraction at moved sites.
reproducibility: Fixed seed from SHA256(namespace+lowercased scientific name) first eight bytes; independent species streams. Do not use historical climate, barriers, AUC or genetic response for acceptance.
rights: Retain per-species summary only; never export IUCN survey range geometry, exact break case coordinates or jittered coordinates.
gate_if_fail: NOT_EVALUABLE_POSITIONAL_SENSITIVITY; do not change radius/attempts or substitute a placebo sensitivity after seeing result
